3D mode uses toIso() projection during playback animation
Error handling: alerts for no arrows and no players near arrows

features_verified: ✓ Chain detection: arrows whose end is near next arrow's start form a chain (CHAIN_DIST=80px)
✓ One player per chain: nearest player to chain's first arrow start follows entire chain
✓ Simultaneous movement: all chains animate at the same time (not sequentially)
✓ Player ends at arrow TIP: after animation, player at LAST arrow's (x2,y2) endpoint
✓ Chained arrows: player follows 3 connected arrows in sequence A→B→C→D
✓ Single arrows: player with 1 arrow reaches destination in step 1 and stays there
✓ Short chains finish early: if chain has 1 segment and maxSegs=3, player stops at step 1 at its tip
✓ Playback bar shows maxSegs as total steps
✓ Stop with keep/restore positions works with chain system
✓ Error handling: no arrows or no players near arrows shows alert
